tldr: 台股 4 月營收 5.3 兆元（年增 30%）創歷史次高，英特爾與輝達合作概念股 + ABF／功率元件漲價助攻挑戰 42,000 點；惟質押潮湧現、台積電壓盤為短線變數。
記憶體族群評等大升：美光大漲 6.5%、AI 帶動「良性循環」；美銀證券一次調升 7 檔記憶體個股，南亞科目標價 440 元、群聯 3,500 元（4 月營收年增分別 717%、237%）。
高盛預估：AI 順差推升台、韓央行均須升息 — 台灣 Q2、Q4 各升半碼，韓國 Q3、Q4 各升 1 碼；台灣 2026 年經常帳順差占 GDP 比重逾 20%、韓國逾 10%。
美伊停火搖搖欲墜、川普醞釀重啟軍事行動；WSJ 爆料阿聯秘密轟炸伊朗煉油廠；油價走高、金價微升；美 4 月 CPI 週二登場、5/13–15 川習會為下一波關鍵。
報稅季倒數：網紅 6/30 前自動補報免罰、領月退每年 85.9 萬元免稅、遺產稅未繳清可提擔保品申辦同意移轉證明書 — 台北國稅局與中區、南區國稅局密集發布實務指引。

items.title_zh: 台股盤前要聞 闖關 4 萬 2 台積電壓盤、質押潮湧現
items.title_en: TAIEX charges at 42,000 with TSMC drag, margin-loan surge in the mix
items.summary_zh: 利多面：AI 投資加速、英特爾與輝達合作概念股（聯電、智原、廣達）、4 月營收歷史次高、ABF 與功率元件漲價循環；利空面：質押潮湧現、高盛預期央行升息、美伊地緣風險推升油價。台積電 ADR 隔夜下跌 1.73%，今日大盤重新挑戰 42,000 點關卡。
items.summary_en: Taiwan pre-market analysts flag both tailwinds and risks as the cash index opens. AI capex re-acceleration, Intel-Nvidia product partnership concept names (UMC, Faraday, Quanta), record-high April revenues, and ABF/power-IC repricing all support upside. Offsetting the bull case: a fresh wave of share-pledge financing among insiders, Goldman's call for two CBC hikes this year, and ongoing US-Iran headline risk lifting oil. TSMC ADR -1.73% overnight could weigh on the open as the index re-tests the 42,000 round level.

items.title_zh: 上市櫃 4 月營收 5.3 兆元（+30.03%）寫最旺 4 月
items.title_en: Listed companies post NT$5.3 tn April revenue (+30% YoY) — second-highest single month on record
items.summary_zh: 4 月合併營收 5.3 兆元、連兩月站穩 5 兆元；累計前 4 月 19.64 兆元、年增 25.57%。152 家公司營收創新高，金融保險（+62.61%）、電子通路（+57.06%）、電腦及周邊（+54.89%）為年增前三大族群。AI 需求加上去年同期美國關稅基期偏低為雙重推力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan-listed and OTC firms together booked NT$5.3 tn in April revenue, +30.03% YoY, the second-strongest single month ever and the strongest April on record. The 4M cumulative is NT$19.64 tn (+25.57% YoY). 152 companies set all-time monthly records; financial-insurance (+62.61%), electronics distribution (+57.06%), and PC/peripherals (+54.89%) led the YoY growth board. AI demand plus a low 2025 base (US tariff shock) drive the surge.

items.title_zh: 營收速報 220 家大型公司 4 月營收 69 家年增逾 25%
items.title_en: Revenue flash — 220 large-caps reported, 69 posted >25% YoY growth
items.summary_zh: 截至 5/12 共 220 家資本額 50 億元以上公司公布 4 月營收：群益證券年增 301.6%（46.48 億元）、華邦電年增 182.2%（192.45 億元）、鼎固-KY 年增 160.9% 為前三大。統一證券月增 3,286.6% 領跑。建材營造與金融保險族群為主要動能。
items.summary_en: Of resigned 50 bn+ cap names that have reported, 69 grew over 25% YoY while 17 fell more than 20%. Top YoY gainers: Capital Securities +301.6% (NT$4.65 bn), Winbond +182.2% (NT$19.25 bn), Ding-Gu KY +160.9%; top MoM gainers led by President Securities +3,286.6%. Construction/building and financial/insurance led the breadth of growth.

items.title_zh: 5/12 盤前｜英特爾輝達攜手大事 不只聯電 這 10 檔概念股提槍上
items.title_en: Intel and Nvidia partner — UMC, Faraday and 10 concept names rally pre-open
items.summary_zh: 英特爾執行長陳立武透露與輝達合作開發「令人興奮的新產品」，激勵聯電、智原、廣達等英特爾概念股再受關注；同時英特爾與 SK 海力士合作 EMIB 整合 HBM、強化 2.5D 先進封裝，凸顯台積電 CoWoS 之外的雙軌新格局。
items.summary_en: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan disclosed an "exciting new product" co-developed with Nvidia, reigniting the Intel-foundry-partnership theme in Taiwan. UMC, Faraday, Quanta and a basket of Intel concept names extend gains pre-market. The disclosure dovetails with separate news that Intel will deepen its 2.5D advanced-packaging push via SK Hynix collaboration on EMIB-integrated HBM, signaling a multi-vendor evolution of advanced packaging beyond TSMC's CoWoS choke point.

items.title_zh: 美光創高 AI 讓記憶體進入「良性循環」
items.title_en: Micron +6.5% to record on AI-driven "memory virtuous cycle"
items.summary_zh: 美光 5/11 大漲 6.5% 至 795.33 美元、市值逼近 9,000 億美元、年初至今漲 178.7%；D.A. Davidson 分析師 Gil Luria 首度給予「買進」、目標價 1,000 美元，認為 AI 把記憶體從循環性大宗商品升級為 AI 基建關鍵元件，三大廠寡占下定價力顯著轉強。費城半導體指數同期漲 69%。
items.summary_en: Micron closed at US$795.33 (+6.5%) on 5/11, intraday +9.6%, a fresh all-time high; market cap nears US$900 bn and YTD return is +178.7%. D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria upgraded to Buy with a US$1,000 target, arguing AI is structurally rerating memory from cyclical-commodity into AI-critical infrastructure with much improved pricing power for the DRAM oligopoly (Micron/Samsung/SK Hynix). The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is up 69% over the same comparison window.

items.title_zh: 記憶體族群外資讚爆 美銀證券一次升評 7 檔
items.title_en: Memory complex re-rated — BofA lifts 7 Taiwan/HK/Korea names, Nanya Tech target NT$440 / Phison NT$3,500
items.summary_zh: 南亞科 4 月營收年增 717%、群聯年增 237%，美銀證券將 DRAM／NAND 單位售價季增上修至 40–50%（高於市場共識 30%）、2026–2028 EPS 預估提高約 10%；南亞科目標價 440 元（外資新天價）、EPS 2026 年 52.7 元／2027 年 58.9 元；群聯目標價 3,500 元；同步升評三星、SK 海力士、Wonik IPS、韓美半導體、ASMPT。
items.summary_en: BofA Securities cites April revenues +717% YoY at Nanya Tech and +237% at Phison and raises 2026–2028 EPS estimates ~10%, with DRAM/NAND ASPs lifting 40–50% QoQ (vs. consensus 30%). Nanya Tech EPS pegged at NT$52.7 (2026) / NT$58.9 (2027); target multiples set at 10x for Samsung, 8x for SK Hynix and Nanya Tech. Wonik IPS, Hanmi Semiconductor and ASMPT also upgraded.

items.title_zh: 味之素漲價 ABF 三雄看旺
items.title_en: Ajinomoto raises ABF prices — Nan Ya PCB, Unimicron, Kinsus targets surge
items.summary_zh: 日本味之素針對個別客戶調漲 ABF 載板價格，大摩認為台廠可 100% 轉嫁、毛利反而擴張。目標價：欣興 1,350 元（野村）／1,100 元（美銀）／1,000 元（大和）；南電 1,222 元（大和）／1,115 元（高盛）／1,100 元（花旗）；景碩 588 元（大和）／555 元（高盛）。高盛預估景碩 Q2 ABF 價格季增 7%、出貨量季增 23%、毛利率 26.2%。因 2–3 個月交期，漲價效益 7 月起顯現。
items.summary_en: Japan's Ajinomoto announced ABF film price hikes on a customer-specific basis. Morgan Stanley sees ABF substrate makers passing through 100% of cost increases to end-customers while expanding margins on strong AI demand. Updated targets: Unimicron NT$1,350 (Nomura) / NT$1,100 (BoA) / NT$1,000 (Daiwa); Nan Ya PCB NT$1,222 (Daiwa) / NT$1,115 (Goldman) / NT$1,100 (Citi); Kinsus NT$588 (Daiwa) / NT$555 (Goldman). Goldman models Q2 ABF prices +7% QoQ, shipments +23% QoQ for Kinsus with gross margin lifting to 26.2%. Pricing effect surfaces from July given 2–3-month lead times.

items.title_zh: 功率元件迎漲價循環！德州儀器再調價＋「去中化」轉單 台鏈受惠股出列
items.title_en: Power-IC repricing cycle — TI raises again, "de-China" reshuffles supply chain
items.summary_zh: 德州儀器 7/1 起調漲類比 IC 與功率元件售價，部分產品漲幅 5–15%；AI 資料中心 800V HVDC 架構、高功率 GPU 伺服器與液冷散熱推升需求。中國功率半導體龍頭揚杰科技遭歐盟制裁，歐美客戶轉單台廠：德微（4 月營收創高）、強茂（4 月 12.97 億元）、茂達（切入 AI PC／伺服器）、致新等；榮景延續至 2027 年。
items.summary_en: Texas Instruments will lift prices on its analog and power product lines starting 7/1, citing higher material, process and supply-chain costs; channel checks point to 5–15% increases on selected SKUs. Demand drivers: 800V HVDC AI data-center architecture, higher-power GPU servers, and broader liquid-cooling adoption. The EU sanction on China's Yangjie Electronics accelerates "de-China" sourcing, sending European/US customers to Taiwan suppliers including De-Way, P-Duke, Mosel, Sino-American Silicon and Niko-Sem; momentum expected to extend into 2027.

items.title_zh: 普利司通關閉新竹湖口廠 資遣 551 名員工
items.title_en: Bridgestone shutters Hsinchu Hukou plant, 551 workers laid off
items.summary_zh: 日商普利司通無預警關閉新竹湖口輪胎廠、資遣 551 名員工，台灣業務改為銷售與服務導向，結束在台多年製造布局；外資製造業在台縮編的訊號之一，與汽車 OEM 需求疲軟同步發生。
items.summary_en: Japanese tire giant Bridgestone abruptly closed its Hsinchu Hukou facility, laying off 551 employees and repivoting Taiwan operations toward sales and service. The shutdown ends decades of local manufacturing and adds to a wave of foreign manufacturer rationalizations in Taiwan as auto-OEM demand softens.

items.title_zh: 金融保險業 4 月營收年增 62.61% — 領跑大盤
items.title_en: Financial-insurance sector April revenue +62.6% YoY — leads broad market
items.summary_zh: 全體上市櫃 4 月營收年增 30% 之中，金融保險族群以 62.61% 居各業之首，超越電子通路、電腦周邊。證券商受惠台股單日成交破兆元、壽險業在美股與高股息 ETF 多頭中認列未實現利益、銀行靠放款成長與財管手續費衝高，台股逼近 42,000 點為主要推手。
items.summary_en: Within the all-listed April revenue print (+30% YoY), financial-insurance topped the YoY growth chart at +62.61%, ahead of electronics distribution and PC/peripherals. Securities-house revenues benefited from sustained TAIEX turnover above NT$1 tn/day; life insurers booked unrealized capital gains as US equities and Taiwan high-yield ETFs rallied; banks gained on loan growth plus wealth-management fees as the index pushed toward 42,000.

items.title_zh: 群益證 4 月營收年增 301.6%、統一證月增 3,286.6%
items.title_en: Capital Securities April revenue +301.6% YoY; President Securities +3,286.6% MoM after merger
items.summary_zh: 群益證 4 月營收 46.48 億元、年增 301.6%，為金融族群增量主力之一；統一證 44.44 億元、月增 3,286.6% 反映合併綜效。證券商手續費與自營收入跟隨台股多頭走高，呼應 5 月初公布的「金融三業 Q1 獲利 3,710 億元創新高」。
items.summary_en: Capital Securities posted NT$4.65 bn April revenue (+301.6% YoY), one of the largest absolute growth contributions among financials; President Securities reported NT$4.44 bn (+3,286.6% MoM) reflecting the recent merger consolidation effect. Broker-side commission and proprietary trading income mirror the TAIEX rally, reinforcing the "Q1+April financial-three-sector record profit" narrative reported earlier this month.

items.title_zh: 基金、主動式 ETF 單一持股放寬至 25% — 「台積電條款」改寫財管商品菜單
items.title_en: Active ETFs and equity funds: single-stock cap lifted to 25% — "TSMC clause" reshapes wealth-product menu
items.summary_zh: 金管會 4 月底放寬國內股票型基金與主動式 ETF 投資單一個股上限至 25%（僅適用台股權重逾 10% 公司，目前僅台積電），財管商品線重新配置。新主動式 ETF（00981A、00403A 等）可加碼台積電；惟集中度風險上升、追蹤誤差貼近 0050，市場示警「alpha 故事」存疑。
items.summary_en: The FSC's late-April rule change allowing domestic equity funds and active ETFs to hold up to 25% in any single name whose TAIEX weighting exceeds 10% (currently only TSMC) is reshaping product designs in 2026. Wealth managers are repositioning model portfolios; new active-ETF launches such as 00981A and 00403A can now load TSMC more aggressively. Caveat: lifting the cap brings concentration risk and lower tracking-error vs. 0050, which may dilute alpha claims.

items.title_zh: 高股息 ETF 配息率向 4–5% 靠攏 — 財管轉向總報酬與資產配置思維
items.title_en: High-dividend ETF yields converging to 4–5%; advisors push core-satellite reshape
items.summary_zh: 2026 年高股息 ETF 殖利率從 2023–2024 年逾 10% 高點向 4–5% 收斂。0056 以 9.36% 年化配息率居冠、00929 6.6%、00940 5.81%、00730 5.72% 維持穩定。財管顧問將對話從「追配息」轉向「總報酬+資產配置」：市值型 ETF（00905／0050）為核心 + 科技成長 ETF + 高息穩定金流，建構「全天候」高資產配置模型。
items.summary_en: As 2026 unfolds, Taiwan's high-dividend ETF cash yields are normalizing toward 4–5% from the 2023–2024 peak of 10%+. 0056 still tops the leaderboard with a 9.36% annualized payout; 00929 (6.6%), 00940 (5.81%) and 00730 (5.72%) maintain steady distributions. Wealth managers shift the conversation from yield-chasing to total-return and asset-allocation: market-cap core (00905/0050) + tech-growth ETF + high-yield sleeve for cash-flow stability — the new "all-weather" wealth model for HNW clients.

items.title_zh: 遺產未完稅 移轉有條件
items.title_en: NTBT: Estates can be transferred before tax is fully paid — via collateral and "consent transfer certificate"
items.summary_zh: 台北國稅局說明：遺產稅未繳清，繼承人若需現金可提供擔保品申請「同意移轉證明書」，即可在繳稅前完成部分財產移轉變現。擔保認定：黃金九折、有價證券八折、公債按面額、銀行存款按本金。實務案例：應納稅 320 萬元、繳交 300 萬定存單擔保，順利出售股票繳稅。法源：《遺贈稅法》第 41 條、《稅捐稽徵法》第 11 條之 1；提擔保不延長繳納期限。
items.summary_en: Taipei Branch of NTBT clarifies that heirs facing cash shortfalls can post acceptable collateral (gold at 90%, listed securities at 80%, public bonds at face, bank deposits at par) to obtain a Consent-to-Transfer Certificate (同意移轉證明書) for partial estate disposal before estate tax is fully settled. Case study: NT$3.2 mn tax due, NT$3.0 mn time-deposit certificate pledged, partial stock sale completed and tax paid. Legal basis: Estate & Gift Tax Act Art. 41 + Tax Collection Act Art. 11-1. Important caveat: posting collateral does not extend the statutory payment deadline.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／獨資、合夥盈餘 要課綜所稅
items.title_en: 2026 filing — sole-proprietors and partnerships must report business profits in personal returns
items.summary_zh: 南區國稅局提醒：獨資、合夥事業本身免繳營所稅（《所得稅法》第 71 條），但商號盈餘須由負責人／合夥人併入個人綜所稅「營利所得」申報；該所得不會自動帶入報稅系統，極易漏報。於檢舉前主動補報，依《稅捐稽徵法》第 48-1 條免處罰。
items.summary_en: South-District NTB reminds owners of sole-proprietorship and partnership entities that despite being exempt from corporate income tax (under Art. 71 ITA), the business profit must still be reported as personal-income-tax "business income". Such income does NOT auto-populate in the e-filing system, leading to chronic under-reporting. Self-correction before notice/audit qualifies for penalty waiver under Tax Collection Act Art. 48-1.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／領月退 全年 85.9 萬免稅
items.title_en: 2026 filing — monthly pension exclusion at NT$859,000/year
items.summary_zh: 高雄國稅局指出：分期領取退職所得，全年免稅額 85.9 萬元（隨物價調整）；舉例月領 10 萬元、全年 120 萬元，扣除後 34.1 萬元列入所得。一次領取：退職服務年資 × 19.8 萬元為基準；兼領者需分別計算；公司應於隔年 1 月底前申報扣繳憑單。
items.summary_en: Kaohsiung NTB clarifies: monthly-installment retirement pension benefits enjoy an annual exclusion of NT$859,000 (the exclusion is CPI-indexed). Example — NT$100,000 monthly / NT$1.2 mn annually = NT$341,000 taxable. For lump-sum payouts, the exclusion equals NT$198,000 × years of service. Mixed lump-sum/monthly arrangements require split-computation. Employers must file withholding statements by January 31 of the following year.

items.title_zh: 2026 報稅／網紅漏稅 6 月底前補報免罰
items.title_en: 2026 filing — under-reporting influencers / streamers can self-correct before 6/30 with no penalty
items.summary_zh: 中區國稅局提醒：個人網紅在 YouTube、Facebook 等平台的廣告分潤、訂閱分潤、直播打賞與斗內，屬「執行業務收入」、須併入綜合所得稅與最低稅負；只要創作者、平台或觀眾任一環節與台灣具經濟關聯，即為台灣來源所得。月營業額逾 5 萬元的「大網紅」須辦稅籍登記、課營業稅。6/30 前主動補報補繳免罰。
items.summary_en: Central-District NTB reminds individual content creators that ad-revenue share, subscription splits, livestream tips and donations from platforms such as YouTube and Facebook qualify as "professional practice income" and must enter the comprehensive PIT computation plus AMT calculation. Source-of-income rule: if creator, platform, or audience touches Taiwan economically, it's Taiwan-source. "Big creators" (over NT$50k/month) must register a business tax ID and pay business tax separately. Voluntary correction before 6/30/2026 → no penalty.

items.title_zh: 財政部提醒：境外金融商品所得須自行申報、退稅詐騙警示
items.title_en: MOF reminders: offshore-investment income filing + tax-refund scam alert
items.summary_zh: 財政部 5/11 新聞稿重申：(1) 民眾投資境外基金、股票、債券所得，須自行併入個人基本所得額申報，匯率換算另有規定；(2) 報稅季「退稅通知」詐騙猖獗，財政部不會以簡訊連結通知退稅。另公布 114 年度國有公用財產活化收益達 467 億餘元創新高。
items.summary_en: MOF's most recent (5/11) news releases highlight: (1) Individual offshore-fund/stock/bond income must be self-declared as part of basic income, with separate FX-conversion timing rules; (2) Filing season scams impersonating "tax refund notices" with embedded links — MOF reminds taxpayers it never issues refunds via SMS links. Separately, MOF reports state-owned property activation revenue of NT$46.7 bn for FY114, a record.

items.title_zh: 高盛：經常帳盈餘新高 台、韓今年必須升息
items.title_en: Goldman: AI surpluses force Taiwan and Korea to hike — back-to-back rate increases for CBC and BOK
items.summary_zh: 高盛預估台灣央行 2026 年 Q2、Q4 各升半碼（12.5 bp），韓國央行 Q3、Q4 各升 1 碼（25 bp）。台灣 2026 經常帳順差占 GDP 逾 20%、韓國逾 10%（IMF 估 18.1%／5.6%）；台灣 Q1 GDP 年增 13.69% 為 1987 年以來最高、全年估近 10%，韓國從 1% 升至 2.5%。台幣與韓元承接升值壓力；高盛警告「K 型景氣」科技與非科技差距擴大。
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs forecasts Taiwan's CBC to raise the policy rate by 12.5 bp in each of Q2 and Q4 2026, and the Bank of Korea to raise 25 bp in each of Q3 and Q4. Drivers: AI-export-driven current-account surpluses of >20% (TW) and >10% (KR) of GDP for 2026 (vs. IMF's 18.1% / 5.6%). Taiwan Q1 GDP growth printed 13.69% — the highest since 1987; full-year 2026 GDP projected near 10% for Taiwan, 2.5% for Korea (up from 1%). FX implication: NTD and KRW face appreciation pressure; Goldman flags "K-shaped" widening between tech and non-tech sectors.

items.title_zh: 總統令發布 7,800 億國防特別條例生效
items.title_en: Presidential decree — NT$780 bn National Defense Special Act takes effect
items.summary_zh: 總統府 5/11 公布「保衛國家安全及強化不對稱戰力計畫採購特別條例」，上限 7,800 億元、立法院 5/8 三讀；卓榮泰院長強調補強「支離破碎」防衛缺口。爭議：無人機採購遭排除、民進黨批「無人機產業成受災區」；美方因金額較行政院版短少 4,700 億元表達失望。
items.summary_en: President Lai Ching-te signed into law the "Special Act for Procurement under the National Security and Asymmetric Defense Enhancement Plan", capping spending at NT$780 bn for US arms procurement; passed by the Legislative Yuan on 5/8. Premier Cho stresses the urgency of repairing "fragmented" defense gaps. Controversy: drones are excluded from this package, drawing DPP criticism of "abandoning the indigenous drone industry"; Washington expressed disappointment that the actual figure is NT$470 bn lower than the executive's request.

items.title_zh: 政院兩招補中油虧損 明年提近 1,700 億元增資
items.title_en: Cabinet's twin-track plan to plug CPC Corp's losses — NT$170 bn capital injection in 2027
items.summary_zh: 經濟部長龔明鑫宣布：央行協調八大公股行庫提供專案融資以避免負債比續升（目前 93%），明年再提近 1,700 億元增資、防止淨值下滑；主計總處研議撥補。中油董事長方振仁指原油備存 140–150 天、天然氣存量 12 天以上（法規 11 天）、Q4 供應樂觀。
items.summary_en: Economic Minister Kung Ming-hsin disclosed that the Executive Yuan has completed project-financing arrangements with state-bank consortium under CBC coordination to prevent further leverage build-up at CPC Corp (debt-to-equity at 93%), while preparing a near-NT$170 bn capital injection plan for 2027 to halt erosion of net worth. CPC chair Fang Cheng-jen says natural-gas supply tension has passed (12+ days inventory vs. 11-day legal minimum) and crude inventory stands at 140–150 days; outlook for Q4 supply is "optimistic" despite Middle East volatility.

items.title_zh: 美股｜記憶體爆發 美光強漲 6.5% 特斯拉、輝達齊揚 台積 ADR 跌 1.73%
items.title_en: US stocks set new highs on memory rally; Trump-Iran headlines lift oil
items.summary_en: S&P 500 and Nasdaq printed fresh all-time highs Monday despite stalled US-Iran negotiations. Philadelphia Semi +2.59%; Micron +6.5%, Tesla +3.91%, Nvidia +1.97%, while Alphabet -2.59% led the Mag-7 lower. Dow +95.31 (+0.19%), S&P +13.91 (+0.19%), Nasdaq +27.05 (+0.10%). WTI crude +2.78% on Trump rebuke of Iran's peace proposal. Trump's 5/13–15 Xi summit and Tuesday's April CPI release are the next focal points; TSMC ADR -1.73%.

items.title_zh: 美伊和談陷僵局 川普考慮重啟對伊軍事行動
items.title_en: US-Iran ceasefire shaky — Trump weighs renewed military action
items.summary_zh: 川普因伊朗最新回覆撤回原本同意的濃縮鈾庫存移交，召開國安會研議重啟軍事行動，選項包括恢復「自由計畫」（協助通過荷姆茲海峽）與已鎖定目標轟炸。出席：副總統范斯、中東特使魏科夫、國務卿盧比歐、國防部長赫格塞斯。若重啟，將推升油價與全球通膨預期，與週二美 4 月 CPI 公布同步發酵。
items.summary_en: Trump convened the NSC after Iran's response to the ceasefire framework, including a walk-back of agreed enriched-uranium handover, fell short of US demands. Options under review include reviving "Operation Freedom" (escorting Strait of Hormuz transit) and pre-planned target strikes. Attendees: VP Vance, Mideast envoy Witkoff, SecState Rubio, SecDef Hegseth. Implication: renewed strikes would re-escalate Gulf risk premium, lift Brent, and feed back into global inflation expectations just as Tuesday's April US CPI is released.

items.title_zh: WSJ：阿聯秘密對伊朗開戰 攻擊煉油廠
items.title_en: WSJ: UAE has been secretly bombing Iranian refineries
items.summary_zh: 《華爾街日報》披露阿聯自 4 月以來秘密對伊朗多次軍事打擊，包括空襲伊朗波斯灣拉萬島煉油廠，迫使設施停擺數月；伊朗以大規模飛彈與無人機報復阿聯與科威特。美國私下表態歡迎、未表不滿；阿聯外交部拒評但保留軍事回應權。意涵：波灣衝突擴大為多邊化、美方安全保證可信度遭重新檢視。
items.summary_en: Wall Street Journal reports the UAE has carried out multiple covert military strikes against Iran since April, including a direct air-attack on the Lavan Island refinery in the Persian Gulf that triggered a months-long shutdown; Iran retaliated with mass missile/drone strikes against UAE and Kuwait. Washington reportedly welcomed UAE's actions privately. UAE Foreign Ministry declined to comment but reserves the right to a military response. Implication: Gulf conflict broadens beyond US-Iran bilateralism, US protection credibility under fresh scrutiny.

items.title_zh: 川普攜 16 位科技金融大咖訪中 黃仁勳意外未受邀
items.title_en: Trump's 16-CEO China entourage — Jensen Huang notably uncovered
items.summary_zh: 川普 5/13–15 訪北京與習近平會談，隨行 16 位企業執行長包含蘋果庫克、特斯拉馬斯克，輝達黃仁勳意外未受邀；焦點為農業、能源、商業航空，而非半導體與 AI。潛在交易：中國採購最多 500 架波音 737 MAX（2017 年以來最大波音訂單）；雙方並研議延長貿易休兵與恢復稀土供應。川普另稱將親自向習近平談對台軍售議題。
items.summary_en: Trump's 5/13–15 visit to Beijing for trade talks with Xi includes 16 US corporate chiefs, headlined by Apple's Tim Cook and Tesla's Elon Musk; Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was conspicuously not invited. Focus areas: agriculture, energy, commercial aviation — NOT semiconductors or AI. Expected deliverable: a potential Boeing order of up to 500 737 MAX aircraft (China's largest Boeing order since 2017); discussions on trade-truce extension and Chinese rare-earth supply resumption. Trump separately said he'll raise US arms sales to Taiwan with Xi directly.

items.title_zh: 〈貴金屬盤後〉美伊再度緊張 金價小漲 本周 CPI 牽動後市
items.title_en: Gold edges higher on US-Iran tension; silver +6.6%; India's PM urges gold buying pause
items.summary_zh: 現貨金 +0.2% 至每盎司 4,723.40 美元、金期 4,728.70；現貨銀 +6.6% 至 85.65；現貨白金 +3% 至 2,116.72；鈀金 +0.8% 至 1,503.11。逢低買盤回流、市場等待美 4 月 CPI；川普駁伊朗提案、5/13–15 訪中；印度總理莫迪呼籲民眾暫停買金以保護外匯存底，衝擊當地珠寶零售業。
items.summary_en: Spot gold +0.2% to US$4,723.40/oz; gold futures US$4,728.70; spot silver +6.6% to US$85.65; spot platinum +3.0% to US$2,116.72; palladium +0.8% to US$1,503.11. Buy-on-dips emerged ahead of US April CPI. Geopolitical layer: Trump's rejection of Iran's offer + 5/13–15 Xi visit. India PM Modi urged citizens to pause gold purchases to protect FX reserves, hitting domestic jewelry retailers.

items.title_zh: 恐慌重現！美國 Google「通膨」搜尋量超 2022 年高點 油價暴增逾 10 倍
items.title_en: US "inflation" Google searches exceed 2022 peak — "oil price" search +1009.6% YoY
items.summary_zh: 美國 Google「通膨」日均搜索 564 萬次（年增 44.9%）已超越 2022 高點；「油價」搜尋量年增 1,009.6%。荷姆茲海峽中斷以來：布蘭特原油 70 → 126 美元；美汽油 2.98 → 4.18 美元／加侖；3 月 CPI 3.3% 兩年新高；密西根消費者信心指數創 1950 年代以來最低。政治意涵：通膨反彈成川普政府期中選舉重大壓力。
items.summary_en: Per Google data, US "inflation" daily-search peaks now exceed 2022's high at 5.64 mn avg daily queries, +44.9% YoY; "oil price" searches +1009.6% YoY. Drivers: Brent surge from US$70 → US$126 since the Hormuz disruption; US gasoline US$2.98 → US$4.18/gal; March CPI 3.3% — a 2-year high; UMich consumer-confidence index at the lowest since the 1950s. Political read-through: inflation rebound is a clear midterm headwind for the Trump administration.
